architecture: Data flow: fetchProducts(page) → useProductFilters hook (state: filters, products, isLoading, error, page, totalPages) → App.tsx → FilterPanel / SortSelect / ProductList
FilterState shape: { search: string; category: string; inStockOnly: boolean; sortBy: 'default' | 'price-asc' | 'price-desc' | 'rating-desc' }
FilterPanel props: { filters: FilterState; onChange: (next: FilterState) => void; categories: string[] }
SortSelect props: { value: FilterState['sortBy']; onChange: (sortBy: FilterState['sortBy']) => void }
filterProducts(products, filters) is called in App.tsx before rendering ProductList — filters apply over the full products array fetched by the hook
New filter/sort logic belongs entirely in src/utils/productFilters.ts inside filterProducts()
New event handler wiring belongs in src/components/FilterPanel.tsx and src/components/SortSelect.tsx — no structural changes needed, only filling in the stubbed callbacks
edgeCases: Search trimming: '  lamp  ' must match 'Desk Lamp' — trim filters.search before comparison (requirement 1)
Search case-insensitivity: 'MOUSE' must match 'Wireless Mouse' — lowercase both sides before comparison (requirement 1)
Empty/whitespace search: when filters.search.trim() === '' no products are excluded (requirement 1)
Category 'All': when filters.category === 'All' all products pass through regardless of actual category (requirement 2)
Filters are applied sequentially: search → category → inStockOnly → sort; sort operates on the already-filtered subset (requirements 1–6)
Array immutability: sort must operate on a copy ([...products] or .slice()) not the original — mutation would corrupt state across sequential test runs (requirement 8)
sortBy 'default': must return products in original order — do not sort at all, just return filtered array as-is (requirement 7)
Empty result set: when all products are excluded filterProducts returns [] and ProductList renders 'No products found.' (requirement 14 — ProductList already handles this)
TypeScript strict mode: all switch/if cases must be exhaustive; no unused variables in new code
Clear filters must reset all four fields: search to '', category to 'All', inStockOnly to false, sortBy to 'default' (requirement 12)

tasks.requirement: Requirements 1–8: filterProducts must apply case-insensitive trimmed partial-match search, exact-match category filter (pass-through when 'All'), inStockOnly exclusion, and sortBy (price-asc, price-desc, rating-desc, default) — sorting on an array copy to avoid mutation
tasks.description: Implement the body of filterProducts() in productFilters.ts. Apply filters in sequence: (1) if filters.search.trim() is non-empty, keep only products whose name.toLowerCase() includes search.trim().toLowerCase(); (2) if filters.category !== 'All', keep only products whose category === filters.category; (3) if filters.inStockOnly, keep only products with inStock === true; (4) if sortBy !== 'default', sort a copy ([...filtered]) by price asc/desc or rating desc before returning. Return the original array order unchanged when sortBy === 'default'.
